title: sibujs-ui project configuration
description: Written by `npx sibujs-ui init`. Tells the CLI where copied files go and which import aliases they use.

registry.description: Registry directory, base URL, or URL template containing {name}. Defaults to the registry bundled with the sibujs-ui CLI.

css.description: Project stylesheet that imports Tailwind. Style and theme `@import` lines are added to it. null: print them instead.

paths.description: Directories, relative to the project root.

aliases.description: Import specifiers that resolve to `paths.ui` and `paths.lib`. Must be declared in tsconfig `paths` and your bundler.
